title: Pricing
description: Control your product pricing strategies, profit margins and discounts across channels, regions, customer groups and stores.
routeNotFound: No pricing page matches this route.

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.description: Group pricing rules and assign them to channels, customer groups, regions and stores to control prices.
priceLists.published: Price list published and applied to store
priceLists.deleteContent: This will permanently delete the price list and its associated prices. Are you sure?
priceLists.searchPlaceholder: Search price lists by name or code...
priceLists.emptyDescription: Create a price list to start controlling and customizing product pricing strategies.
priceLists.priorityHint: Higher priority number applies first when multiple lists match the customer.
priceLists.inclusiveHint: Displayed price already includes VAT/Tax (recommended for B2C retail).
priceLists.exclusiveHint: Displayed price is net and tax is added at checkout (recommended for B2B wholesale).

detail.publishConfirmContent: This will publish the price list and apply its prices immediately in the store for assigned targets.
detail.archiveConfirmContent: This price list will become read-only and preserved for historical records only.

banners.draft: This price list is currently a Draft and will not take effect in the storefront until you click 'Publish price list'.
banners.published: This price list is published and active, currently applying prices according to assigned channels, stores, and groups.
banners.inactive: This price list is temporarily paused; its prices will not apply until you reactivate it.
banners.archived: This price list is archived and cannot be edited or applied.

tabDescriptions.products: Products priced under this price list. You can edit their prices, add quantity tiers, or set margin constraints.
tabDescriptions.channels: Sales channels eligible for this price list (e.g. Web Store, Mobile App, POS).
tabDescriptions.customerGroups: Customer segments eligible for this price list (e.g. Wholesale, VIP clients).
tabDescriptions.regions: Countries and geographic regions where this price list applies.
tabDescriptions.stores: Specific store locations and branches where this price list applies.
tabDescriptions.versions: Audit trail showing all version changes and timestamps on this price list.

detail.addProductPrice: Add product price to this list
detail.removeChannelConfirm: Remove sales channel from this list?
detail.removeGroupConfirm: Remove customer group from this list?
detail.noProductsAssigned: No product prices assigned to this list yet
detail.noChannelsAssigned: Applies to all sales channels by default unless specific channels are selected.
detail.noGroupsAssigned: Applies to all customer groups by default unless specific groups are selected.
detail.noRegionsAssigned: Applies to all geographic regions by default unless specific regions are selected.
detail.noStoresAssigned: Applies to all stores and branches unless specific stores are selected.

guidance.productsMessage: Set explicit prices for products in this list. Any product not listed here will fall back to its standard base price. You can also define bulk quantity tiers and margin protection constraints.
guidance.productsNote: To add a price for a product, click the 'Add product price to this list' button.
guidance.channelsMessage: Assign this price list to specific sales channels (e.g. exclusive prices for the Mobile App, Point of Sale (POS), or Marketplace platform).
guidance.channelsNote: If left empty, this price list will automatically apply to all sales channels.
guidance.groupsMessage: Restrict this price list to specific customer segments (e.g. B2B wholesale clients, VIP customers, or registered subscribers).
guidance.groupsNote: If left empty, all customers (retail and registered) can purchase at these prices.
guidance.regionsMessage: Apply location-based pricing by customer country or region (e.g. dedicated prices for Saudi Arabia, UAE, or GCC countries).
guidance.regionsNote: If left empty, this price list will apply globally to all countries and regions.
guidance.versionsMessage: A complete audit trail documenting all revisions made to this price list, recording who made changes, the timestamp, and the version number.

productPrices.title: Product prices

productPrices.emptyDescription: Add a price for a product within a price list.
productPrices.compareAtHint: Shows as strikethrough to highlight customer savings (must be higher than base price).
productPrices.costHint: Product unit cost, used to calculate profit and apply margin protection constraints.
productPrices.minPriceHint: Safety threshold: discounts and coupons cannot reduce price below this floor.
productPrices.maxPriceHint: Maximum price ceiling for this product.
productPrices.bulkTiersHint: Automatically lower unit price when customer purchases higher volume.
productPrices.constraintsHint: Rules preventing pricing mistakes and protecting store profits.
